name: Knowledge-enhanced Benchmark Evolution (KBE)
description: KBE is a dynamic multimodal evaluation framework that transforms static benchmarks into controllable, evolving versions by integrating multimodal knowledge. It reconstructs and expands questions using visual and external textual knowledge, enabling difficulty-controllable evaluation and addressing data contamination and saturation issues in multimodal large language model assessments.
reputation: A very recent benchmark framework proposed to address contamination and saturation in multimodal evaluation, with adoption still emerging.
notes: Uses graph formulation to represent VQA samples and enables dynamic benchmark evolution with difficulty control.
